name: Versine
long_description:
We're building consumer banking for AI agents and humans. 

To start, Versine lets your agents send and receive money, like Venmo for agents.

Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Muse or your own agent through our MCP. Here are some things that your agent can do:

1. Send money to anyone with your passkey approval to / from up to 100 people with one prompt
2. Pay people without a Versine account (they cash out to their bank in 2 minutes)
3. Transfer funds to trusted contacts without your explicit approval (you can set this)

We imagine a world where your agent can see everything you see and hear everything you hear. In that world, assistants need the ability to perform banking operations on behalf of their users and for their users’ benefit.
